rows.workedCase: Across t=0.10 to 0.14 s let f rise from 100 to 108 Hz. The local estimate f-dot≈(108-100)/(0.14-0.10)=200 Hz/s is an interval slope, not a claim of exactly constant instantaneous rate. If endpoint frequency uncertainty is ±1 Hz each and time error is neglected, a conservative endpoint bound is ±2/0.04=±50 Hz/s; changing window/noise changes that bound. In the supplied leading relation Mc=C f-dot^(3/5) f^(-11/5), doubling f-dot at fixed f multiplies Mc by 2^(3/5), while doubling f at fixed f-dot multiplies it by 2^(-11/5). At fixed total mass 10, pairs (5,5) and (2,8) have product25 and16: their chirp-mass ratio is (25/16)^(3/5), not1. The result still does not identify both component masses.

Reading individual graph values or only integer exponent laws cannot replace contextual division by the matching time interval and interpretation of fifth-root/reciprocal scaling. A calculator may evaluate the power but does not explain why 2^(3/5) differs from2 or why a negative exponent is reciprocal. Full88abc886 includes positive and negative rational forms present in the model; fullae20183e includes interval/unit/sign limitations present in extraction.
